description_en: Clones a new data source based on an existing data source
description_zh: 根据已有的数据源，克隆一条新的数据源
name: CloneDataSource

parameters.help_en: The data source ID. This is the unique identifier of the data source
parameters.help_zh: 数据源ID，数据源的唯一标识符
parameters.name: id

parameters.help_en: The name of the destination data source. The name can contain letters, digits, and underscores, and cannot start with a digit or underscore. The name can be up to 60 characters in length
parameters.help_zh: 目标数据源的名称，由字母、数字、下划线组合，且不能以数字和下划线开头，最长60个字符
parameters.name: clone_data_source_name

Id.description_en: The ID of the cloned data source. This is the unique identifier of the data source
Id.description_zh: 返回克隆创建的数据源ID，数据源的唯一标识符

RequestId.description_en: The request ID. Used to locate logs and troubleshoot issues
RequestId.description_zh: 请求 ID。用于定位日志，排查问题
